question: I need to create a sales performance dashboard for our Chinese regional teams. First, I want a map showing our 2025 sales distribution across provinces - we have data showing Guangdong had ¥15.8M, Jiangsu ¥12.3M, Zhejiang ¥9.7M, Shandong ¥8.4M, and Beijing ¥7.2M. Then create an area chart showing monthly sales trends from January to December 2025, with values: Jan: 1.2M, Feb: 1.1M, Mar: 1.4M, Apr: 1.6M, May: 1.8M, Jun: 2.1M, Jul: 2.3M, Aug: 2.2M, Sep: 2.5M, Oct: 2.7M, Nov: 3.0M, Dec: 3.5M. Finally, make a column chart comparing our top product categories across regions: Electronics (Guangdong: 6.2M, Jiangsu: 4.8M), Home Appliances (Guangdong: 4.5M, Jiangsu: 3.9M), and Clothing (Guangdong: 5.1M, Jiangsu: 3.6M).
answer:
All three charts for your 2025 sales dashboard are ready.

## 1. Provincial Sales Distribution (2025)
A China provincial heat map, value-scaled in millions of yuan (百万元).

| Province | Sales | Share of the 5 tracked regions |
|---|---|---|
| 广东 Guangdong | ¥15.8M | 29.6% |

| 浙江 Zhejiang | ¥9.7M | 18.2% |

| **Total** | **¥53.4M** | 100% |

Guangdong and Jiangsu together account for over half (52.7%) of these five markets — the southern/eastern coastal cluster is clearly the core.

## 2. Monthly Sales Trend (Jan–Dec 2025)
```vis-chart
{"type":"area","title":"2025年月度销售额趋势","data":[{"time":"1月","value":1.2},{"time":"2月","value":1.1},{"time":"3月","value":1.4},{"time":"4月","value":1.6},{"time":"5月","value":1.8},{"time":"6月","value":2.1},{"time":"7月","value":2.3},{"time":"8月","value":2.2},{"time":"9月","value":2.5},{"time":"10月","value":2.7},{"time":"11月","value":3},{"time":"12月","value":3.5}],"axisXTitle":"月份","axisYTitle":"销售额（百万元）","theme":"default","lineWidth":"3","width":800,"height":420}
```

Total year: **¥24.4M**, with a strong upward trajectory from ¥1.2M in January to ¥3.5M in December (~2.9×). January–December growth is nearly monotonic except a small dip in February (Chinese New Year seasonality) and a minor plateau in August. Q4 alone contributes ¥9.2M — 38% of the year — so your year-end push is doing the heavy lifting.

## 3. Product Category Comparison by Region
```vis-chart
{"type":"column","title":"重点品类区域销售额对比","data":[{"category":"电子产品","value":6.2,"group":"广东"},{"category":"电子产品","value":4.8,"group":"江苏"},{"category":"家用电器","value":4.5,"group":"广东"},{"category":"家用电器","value":3.9,"group":"江苏"},{"category":"服装","value":5.1,"group":"广东"},{"category":"服装","value":3.6,"group":"江苏"}],"group":true,"stack":false,"axisXTitle":"产品品类","axisYTitle":"销售额（百万元）","width":800,"height":420}
```

| Category | 广东 | 江苏 | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| 电子产品 Electronics | ¥6.2M | ¥4.8M | +1.4M |
| 家用电器 Home Appliances | ¥4.5M | ¥3.9M | +0.6M |
| 服装 Clothing | ¥5.1M | ¥3.6M | +1.5M |
| **Region total** | **¥15.8M** | **¥12.3M** | +3.5M |

Guangdong leads in every category and its three-category total exactly matches the provincial figure (¥15.8M), so these categories are effectively its full product mix. Electronics is the single biggest line in both regions; Home Appliances is the weakest and the least differentiated (only ¥0.6M apart), suggesting the most headroom for a Jiangsu-focused push.

**Dashboard layout suggestion:** map as the wide hero panel at top, monthly trend beneath it (both are regional/time overviews), and the category comparison in a side column for drill-down. All three share a consistent blue-forward palette so they read as one system.
